rows.definition: The env var (default defaultClaudeMacGateway = http://node-macos-a.local:8080) naming the HTTP base URL of the user's own Mac Metal `fak serve` gateway that `fak claude-mac-fak` and the compute-target auto-selector dial as the 'mac' cost-class target.
rows.distinction: A specific COMPUTE-TARGET address for one remote Mac box - NOT DefaultGatewayBaseURL (the generic client-wiring default used when no target is picked).

rows.definition: The Prometheus metric-name NAMESPACE prefix grouping every vDSO-specific series (fak_vdso_lookups_total, fak_vdso_hits_total, fak_vdso_hit_rate, fak_vdso_cache_fills_total, fak_vdso_invalidations_total, fak_vdso_misses_total) rendered by writeVDSOMetrics, kept alongside the fak_engine_cache_* and fak_cache_* families on /metrics.
rows.distinction: The metric-name PREFIX/family grouping - NOT FakVDSOAvoidedCalls (one specific avoided-call counter folded into the cache-savings report; fak_vdso is explicitly excluded from fak_cache_saved_by_mechanism because its witness is avoided calls, emitted separately).

rows.definition: A cmd/fak helper (cachevalue_report.go / cachevalue.go / cachevalue_status.go) that drops durable gateway-usage ledger rows dated before a caller-supplied `since` cutoff, using gatewayUsageRowDate to parse each row's date.
rows.distinction: A report-time READ-SIDE filter over already-durable rows - NOT persistGatewayUsageObservation (the exit-time WRITER that appends a new row to the same ledger).

rows.definition: The CacheCreationTierProvenanceGatewayAttributed constant value ("gateway_attributed") stamped on a Track-2 row's CacheCreationTierProvenance field to mark its CacheCreationTokensUpgraded split as fak's own per-turn upgrade witness (#2179), not a provider-reported 5m/1h split.
rows.distinction: A cache-TIER-SPLIT provenance tag (who attributed the 1h-vs-5m creation-token split) - NOT EngineModel (provenance) which tags which engine served a request.

rows.definition: A PreflightProbe bool field (internal/livecodebench and internal/terminalbench) recording whether the benchmark preflight even attempted the fak-gateway reachability probe, gating whether GatewayReachable's value can be trusted.
rows.distinction: Whether the probe was ATTEMPTED at all - NOT GatewayReachable (the probe's positive/negative RESULT once attempted).

rows.definition: A liveness READ over the fak gateway's TCP listener: the nightrun package var gatewayReachable dials "host:port" with a short timeout, and the same-named PreflightProbe.GatewayReachable field in livecodebench/terminalbench preflights records that a `fak_gateway_reachable` gate passed.
rows.distinction: A positive REACHABILITY result - NOT GatewayChecked (whether the probe ran) and NOT GatewayUnreachable (the negative/error status code a different subsystem, dgxbridge, reports).

rows.definition: The internal/dgxbridge LabGatewayUnreachable status string ("GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE"), set by NewLabReadiness when a lab-readiness probe's GatewayError bit is true, driving the DGX lab-dispatch gate's next_action to "recover-private-gateway".
rows.distinction: A DGX lab-readiness STATUS CODE (one of LabReadyForDevWork/LabWaitPrivateRecover/LabGatewayUnreachable/LabAuthChannelBlocked/LabIndeterminate) - NOT GatewayReachable/GatewayChecked, the unrelated bench-preflight probe bits.

rows.definition: The AuditReportInput.GatewayUsage field (internal/auditusage) holding a GatewayUsageInput - the audit shell's own read of docs/nightrun/gateway-usage.jsonl (Path/Present/Rows, no chain-of-custody), folded by foldGateway into the report's GatewayRollup.
rows.distinction: The AUDIT-SIDE read struct for the ledger's rows - NOT persistGatewayUsageObservation (the gateway-side writer that appends those rows) and NOT the gatewayusageledger package itself (the durable-ledger implementation).

rows.definition: A gatewayMetrics method (internal/gateway/metrics_snapshot.go) that builds the []inKernelOOMSnapshot rows consumed by both the /debug/vars OOM block and the /metrics renderer, folding the live in-kernel OOM accumulator into a stable, serializable snapshot.
rows.distinction: The snapshot-BUILDING method that renders a point-in-time []inKernelOOMSnapshot for two consumers - NOT InKernelOOMRetryStats (the underlying retry-count accumulator it reads) and NOT InKernelOOMError (the error type an OOM raises).

rows.definition: A gateway.SessionHarness field (json kernel_cpu_percent) carrying the harnessres.Half.CPUPercentAvg() reading for the harness's "kernel" half - the guard + in-process gateway PID sampled continuously - exposed live on /debug/vars and via guard_endpoints.go's guardHarnessToSession.
rows.distinction: Average CPU UTILIZATION (%) of the guard/gateway process itself over elapsed wall time - NOT KernelCPUSeconds (cumulative CPU time) and NOT KernelCounters (turnbench) (an unrelated internal/kernel dispatch-counter struct that reuses the word 'kernel' for the vDSO/adjudication core, not this OS-resource sampler's process half).

rows.definition: A gateway.SessionHarness field (json kernel_cpu_seconds) carrying harnessres.Half.CPUSeconds() (user+system time) for the harness's guard+in-process-gateway "kernel" half, read by guardHarnessToSession when k.HaveCPU is set.
rows.distinction: Cumulative CPU TIME in seconds of the guard/gateway process - NOT KernelCPUPercent (the same axis normalized to a percent-of-wall-clock rate).

rows.definition: A gateway.SessionHarness field (json kernel_io_read_bytes) carrying harnessres.Half.IOReadBytes for the guard+in-process-gateway "kernel" half, populated by guardHarnessToSession when k.HaveIO is set and rendered live at /debug/vars and in the guard exit summary (guard_endpoints.go, info_endpoints.go).
rows.distinction: Bytes READ from disk by the guard/gateway process - NOT KernelIOWriteBytes (the paired write-side counter on the same I/O axis).

rows.definition: A gateway.SessionHarness field (json kernel_io_write_bytes) carrying harnessres.Half.IOWriteBytes for the guard+in-process-gateway "kernel" half, populated by guardHarnessToSession when k.HaveIO is set alongside KernelIOReadBytes.
rows.distinction: Bytes WRITTEN to disk by the guard/gateway process - NOT KernelIOReadBytes (the paired read-side counter).

rows.definition: A gateway.SessionHarness field (json kernel_rss_bytes) carrying harnessres.Half.RSSBytes - the live resident-set-size reading for the guard+in-process-gateway "kernel" half - populated by guardHarnessToSession when k.HaveRSS is set and rendered via guardInfoBytesText in the guard's live status line.
rows.distinction: Live process memory (RSS) of the guard/gateway - NOT the unrelated internal/kernel dispatch core's counters (KernelCounters (turnbench)), which reuse 'kernel' for the vDSO/adjudication engine, not this harness's OS-resource sampler.

rows.definition: A gateway.Server method (internal/gateway/metrics_http.go, called from gateway.go's adjudicate/syscall paths and gateway_admit.go) that records ONE gateway operation's outcome inline into the live fak_gateway_operation_duration_seconds/fak_gateway_operations_total counters at call time.
rows.distinction: The live, PER-CALL metrics recorder invoked inline on every adjudicate/syscall - NOT persistGatewayUsageObservation (a single durable ledger ROW appended once, at process exit, summarizing the whole session).
